Korean provinces are named after its leading cities.
For example, the province of 충청도 derives its name from cities of 충주 and 청주.

Likewise 경상도 is named after 경주 and 상주.

We lived about an hour from 경주, 55km the site of Shilla Dynasty capital 
But we didn't fully take advantage of it.
Much like visiting downtown DC when visitors came, when we lived in Maryland.

We bought a sterilizer made in Barcelona, Spain.
First the installers came, with their local wine hid away inside the chamber.
They were a gregarious bunch.
Played a soccer match
A local version of Spain vs Korea, foreshadowing the 2002 World Cup.

Then the owners came.
They explained they go to installation sites, wherever the equipment is installed.

I was impressed.
Vowed to follow their leads
Followe

```{r}
library(leaflet)

locations <- data.frame(
  name = c("구미", "동대구역", "경주", "부산역"),
  lat  = c(36.1195, 35.8802, 35.8562, 35.1151),
  lon  = c(128.3446, 128.6286, 129.2247, 129.0414)
)

leaflet(locations) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon,
    lat = ~lat,
    radius = 7,
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    popup = ~name,
    label = ~name
  ) |>
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = min(locations$lon),
    lat1 = min(locations$lat),
    lng2 = max(locations$lon),
    lat2 = max(locations$lat)
  )

```
